event-propagation.pseudocode:
def dispatch(event, target):
    path, node = [], target.parent
    while node:  # 조상 경로 수집 (window … 부모)
        path.insert(0, node)
        node = node.parent
    for node in path:  # ① 캡처링: 위에서 아래로
        call_listeners(node, event, phase='capture')
        if event.stopped:
            return
    call_listeners(target, event, phase='target')  # ②
    if not event.bubbles or event.stopped:
        return
    for node in reversed(path):  # ③ 버블링: 아래에서 위로
        call_listeners(node, event, phase='bubble')
        if event.stopped:  # stopPropagation() 호출됨
            return
